name: hub
//: PULSE hub UI - the owner's console. Next.js App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui, exported statically to out/ which the pulse binary embeds (crates/pulse-hub/src/server.rs, rust-embed). out/ is committed on purpose: cargo build needs no Node.
dev:        `npm run dev` on :3000 proxies /api/* to the pulse hub - run `pulse hub --no-browser --port 8787` first (PULSE_HUB_PORT overrides the port).
dev:mock:   `npm run dev:mock` runs mock/server.mjs (fixtures in mock/api/**.json, writes answered in memory, SSE at /api/v1/events/stream) on :8787 and next dev on :3000. No hub needed.

build:      `npm run build` = static export to out/ (commit out/ after UI changes). `npm run serve:out` serves out/ plus the mock API on :8787 (the same layout the pulse hub serves) for a last look at the export.

check:      `npm run check` = typecheck (tsc --noEmit) + lint (eslint) + a build exported to the scratch dir PULSE_HUB_OUT_DIR=.next/check-out (gitignored, eslint-ignored; see next.config.ts), so verifying never rewrites the committed out/. Only `npm run build` regenerates out/. All API calls are relative /api/v1/...; the TypeScript contract lives in src/lib/api.ts.

routes:     / (hub), /project/?slug=&tab=, /tasks/, /votes/?project=&status=&kind=, /records/?id=, /compute/, /settings/, /agents/, /harness/, /connections/?project=&tab= - state in search params, no dynamic segments.

design:     "the daily briefing" - plain words (src/lib/words.ts is the vocabulary: runner, machines, private tests, statusWord()), marigold only for what waits on the owner, flat cards, details folded. Tokens live in src/app/globals.css (oklch palette from .github/assets/pulse-logo.svg; teal primary, marigold `you`, series colours for charts). Atkinson Hyperlegible Next and Mono are vendored in public/fonts (latin + latin-ext, OFL-atkinson-*.txt alongside) so the export needs no network at build or run time.

overrides:  hono is a transitive dev dependency (shadcn -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk). The override pins it to the newest patched release that was at least 3 days old when adopted (the owner's release-age rule, 2026-10-26); bump or drop the pin when a newer release is old enough.

scripts.dev:mock: node mock/server.mjs & MOCK=$!; PULSE_HUB_PORT=${PULSE_HUB_PORT:-8787} next dev; kill $MOCK
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && PULSE_HUB_OUT_DIR=.next/check-out npm run build && npm run test
